body: (Ah, it looks like perhaps you folks fixed this by instead removing the explicit `width` and `height` from the `<symbol>` element in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/2675/commits/03834157620720e97e9856169d89d1ce2db158ea .
